sql: SELECT TOP 10 gc.CardNumber AS voucherNumber, gc.Name AS name, gc.Amount AS amount, gc.RemainingAmount AS remainingAmount FROM dbo.ZnodeGiftCard gc INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = gc.PortalId WHERE po.StoreCode = @store AND gc.IsActive = @isActive AND gc.RestrictToCustomerAccount = @restrictedToCustomer AND gc.StartDate <= @now AND gc.ExpirationDate >= @now AND gc.RemainingAmount >= @minBalance AND (@preferred IS NULL OR gc.CardNumber = @preferred) ORDER BY gc.GiftCardId
